{"metadata":{"description":"OS-keychain credentials provider (Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service) for the DeepSeek Harness credential seam","id":"gh:1336199279","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-credentials-keyring","slug":"irisnb/dsh-credentials-keyring","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"OS-keychain credentials provider (Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service"},{"id":"p1s2","text":") for the DeepSeek Harness credential seam"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-credentials-keyring"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"An OS-keychain credentials provider for the DeepSeek Harness credential seam (`ctx.credentials`)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"It stores API keys and other secrets in the operating system's **native** credential store — **Windo"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ws Credential Manager**, **macOS Keychain**, or **Linux Secret Service** — instead of the plain-text"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" file used by the built-in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials-local`."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> 中文说明见文末。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness ships a credentials seam (`ctx.credentials`) with exactly one provider, `dsh-creden"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"tials-local`, which writes secrets to a `.credentials.yaml` / `.env` file. The Harness's own docs ma"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"rk the OS-keychain provider as *deferred*:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> an OS-keychain provider — a store the model's processes cannot read at all — is the deferred answe"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"r and belongs beside this provider as a sibling package."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"This package is that sibling provider. It keeps the same four-operation seam (`resolve` / `describe`"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" / `set` / `unset`), so mounting it changes **where secrets live**, not how consumers read them — LL"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"M adapters and other consumers keep calling `ctx.credentials.resolve()` unchanged."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Not published to npm yet — install straight from the Git repository:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The compiled `lib/` output is committed, so the Git install works without a build step."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Peer dependencies are `@deepseek-ai/cordis` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials`; install them to matc"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"h the Harness version you run against."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The provider implements `CredentialProvider`, so it plugs into the `credentials` seam and stores one"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" value per credential reference (a POSIX identifier such as `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Config"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Field | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| `service` | `com.deepseek.dsh` | Keychain service namespace. Set it to your app's identifier so yo"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ur secrets never collide with another app's. |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Every other value lives in the keychain under `(service, account)`, where `account` is the credentia"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"value lives in the keychain under `(service, account)`, where `account` is the credential reference."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Semantics"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- `resolve(ref)` → `{ value, source: 'keyring' }` when stored, `undefined` when absent or empty.
- `"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"describe(ref)` → `{ configured, source?, writable }` — **never the value**.
- `set(ref, value)` → st"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ores; rejects an empty value (use `unset`).
- `unset(ref)` → deletes; deleting an absent entry is a "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"no-op.
- `set` / `unset` emit `credentials/updated` after committing, like every provider."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Platform support and degradation"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The native layer is `@napi-rs/keyring` (the Rust `keyring` crate behind an N-API binding). It is loa"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ded **lazily** and probed once:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **Windows / macOS / Linux (with Secret Service)** — full support.
- **Headless Linux without Secre"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"t Service** — the provider still mounts, but `describe()` reports `writable: false`, `resolve()` ans"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"wers "absent", and `set()` throws a clear error. It never silently pretends a secret was stored."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Unit tests inject an in-memory `KeyringBackend`, so they run everywhere without touching the OS keyc"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"hain. The one file that depends on `@napi-rs/keyring`'s exact API is `NapiKeyringBackend`; its "not "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"found" error mapping should be re-verified against the pinned version with a one-off smoke test on a"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" real machine before release."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Security note"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Secrets never enter this package's public API as config values; they move between the caller and the"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" OS keychain only. Keep in mind the OS keychain protects against *other processes on the machine* an"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"d *plain-text leaks on disk* — it does not hide a secret from a caller your own code chose to trust."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"MIT"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## 中文说明"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"这是给 DeepSeek Harness 凭据接缝（`ctx.credentials`）写的「系统钥匙串」提供方：把 API Key 等秘密存进操作系统原生凭据存储（Windows 凭据管理器 / m"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"acOS 钥匙串 / Linux Secret Service），替代内置的明文文件实现 `dsh-credentials-local`。"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"它实现与内置提供方完全相同的四个操作（`resolve` / `describe` / `set` / `unset`），所以挂上去之后，所有读取凭据的消费者（如 LLM 适配器）**一行都不用改**"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"。唯一可配置项是 `service`（钥匙串命名空间，默认 `com.deepseek.dsh`）。"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"无图形界面的 Linux 上原生层不可用时，插件仍能挂载，但会明确报「不可写」，绝不静默假装存成功。单元测试用内存后端，不碰真实钥匙串。"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"安装：目前尚未发布到 npm，可直接从 Git 仓库安装："},{"id":"p39s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"仓库已提交编译产物 `lib/`，所以 Git 安装后无需再手动 build。"}],"truncated":false}
